title: Playboy Magazine November 1973 German Edition Ursula Andress Deutsch
conditionDescription: Pre-owned vintage issue, complete. Normal signs of age and storage; cover wear, scuffs, creases and edge/corner wear consistent with a magazine of this age. Please review the photos for exact condition. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, November 1973 - GERMAN LANGUAGE EDITION.
Nr. 11, November 1973, 5 DM. "Alles was Maennern Spass macht."

Cover lines include: Ein erregendes Heft, Neuer Sex-Report erregt die Welt, Studenten erregen sich selbst, Zigarren erregen Maenner... und Ursula Andress auch.

This is the German-language edition, not the US edition.

NOTE ON THE PHOTOS: this issue is at TOP LEFT in the group photo and SECOND FROM BOTTOM in the stack photo.
